Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this game! The action from T20 World Cup Qualifier A continues and Ireland will go up against Germany in their next game on Monday, 21st February. That game begins at 11.30 am IST (6 am GMT). Do join us then and make sure you tune in early for the buildup. Cheers!

Gareth Delany is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that it was a tricky start for him but George Dockrell helped along well. Tells that they had a disappointing start as they lost to UAE but they knew that they need to win the remaining games in order to qualify for the semis. Says that they have got the win here and will now look forward to get a win against Germany as well.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that it was a tough game and they are happy to end up on the right side. Tells that Craig Young has been bowling well for them and applauds him for the way he bowled in this match. Adds that Dockrell and Delany batted well and they knew that it was always going to be tough to beat Bahrain.

Bahrain skipper, Sarfaraz Ali is up for a chat. He says that it was a tough game but will come back stronger in the next game. Tells that the bowlers bowled well but the last 5 overs cost them the match. Adds that they are enjoying their cricket and hopefully they will do their best next time.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Ireland bowlers were clinical as they didn't allow the game to drift away from them at any point. All the bowlers, apart from Josh Little, stuck to their task and kept Bahrain's batters on toes. Craig Young snared three wickets while the spinners got one wicket apiece. All in all, it was a dominant performance from the Irish team. Ireland have now moved up and secured the third spot in the points table. They will now need to win their next game against Germany in order to qualify for the semi-final.

Bahrain had a decent target to chase and their openers, Muhammad Younis and Sarfaraz Ali did lay a decent foundation. Although, once Bahrain lost both of them, they were in a spot of bother. None of the other batters got going and the required rate kept creeping up. David Mathias held one end but even he was unable to find boundaries at regular intervals. They kept on losing wickets at the backend and were handed a comprehensive defeat. Sathaiya Veerapathiran did hit a few lusty blows in the end overs but it was too little too late for Bahrain.

A pretty comfortable victory in the end for Ireland. Their bowlers stuck to their plans and made sure that Bahrain's batters don't run away with the chase. They kept their calm even though they failed to make early inroads and Bahrain never looked like chasing down the total once their opening stand was broken.
Floats it up, on middle. Sathaiya Veerapathiran gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single. IRELAND WIN BY 21 RUNS!
This is pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Sathaiya Veerapathiran slices it to deep cover for a brace.
SIX! Wow! Loopy ball, on middle. Sathaiya Veerapathiran hammers it all the way over long on for a biggie.
Outside off, Sathaiya Veerapathiran misses his cut.
SIX! Short and on middle, Sathaiya Veerapathiran pulls it to fine leg for a maximum.
WIDE! Short and wide, outside off, beyond the tramline. Wide called.
On middle, Safdar heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Outside off, on a length. Muhammad Safdar heaves across the line and misses.
FOUR! Too little too late for Bahrain! Short ball, on middle. Muhammad Safdar miscues his pull. The ball goes off the top edge to deep square leg for a boundary.
On a good length, on middle. Muhammad Safdar swings across the line but misses once again.
WIDE! Length ball, down leg. Left alone. Wided.
Short of a length, on middle. Muhammad Safdar swings but misses.
Short ball, on middle. Sathaiya Veerapathiran pulls it without any timing to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Muhammad Safdar cuts it behind point for a brace.
Outside off, Sathaiya Veerapathiran cuts it to deep point for a run.
This is pushed straight down the ground but only for a single.
SIX! Two in a row! Short and on middle, Sathaiya Veerapathiran stands tall and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for another biggie.
SIX! BOOM! Loopy ball, on middle. Sathaiya Veerapathiran gets low on one knee and pumps it over long on for a maximum.
Muhammad Safdar walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Bahrain lose their fifth wicket now. Quicker delivery, on middle. David Mathias smacks it to deep mid-wicket. Not enough power on that one though. Harry Tector settles under it and takes his third catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On off, pushed to cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Slapped! Short of a length, outside off. David Mathias slaps it towards sweeper cover for a boundary.
Bangs a short ball, on off. David Mathias looks to pull but misses.
Back of a length, on middle. David Mathias works it to wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball, on off. Sathaiya Veerapathiran lifts it over the bowler's head for a single.
On a length, on off. Pushed past the bowler to mid off for a run.
On middle, kept out.
This is eased down to long off for a single.
On the pads, it is nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Sathaiya Veerapathiran is the new man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Loopy ball, on middle. Haider Ali Butt heaves it to long on. The ball does not have enough legs to clear the ropes and Harry Tector there takes the catch this time.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Tossed up, on middle. Haider Ali Butt smacks it to deep mid-wicket. Harry Tector there went for the catch but the ball bounces in front of him and goes over the ropes.
On middle, swept to short fine leg.
A short ball, around off. Haider Ali Butt gets low and flat-bats it through the cover region for only a run. 78 runs needed off 30 balls.
A short ball, outside off. David Mathias pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Ireland won't mind the singles here! Bahrain badly need some maximums!
Back of a length, on middle. David Mathias keeps it out watchfully.
A short ball, on middle. David Mathias dabs it onto the deck.
Short of a length, outside off. David Mathias looks to cut but he misses.
Back of a length, around middle. Haider Ali Butt flicks it to the leg side and takes a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. David Mathias taps it to the off side. A dot to end the over!
FOUR! Top shot! A loopy ball, on middle. David Mathias skips down the track and just lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Haider Ali Butt drives this full ball towards long on and collects a single.
On a length, around off. David Mathias drives it to long on for a single.
Floated, on middle. David Mathias drills it straight back to the bowler. No run there!
Tossed up, on middle. Haider Ali Butt drills it towards long on for one run.
Short of a length, around off. Haider Ali Butt taps it towards point for a quick single.
FOUR! Deft touch! A short ball, outside off. Haider Ali Butt hangs back and just ramps it over the keeper's head to bag a boundary.
A full ball, on middle. David Mathias nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Haider Ali Butt punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, around off. Haider Ali Butt keeps it out.
Haider Ali Butt walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Big wicket this for Ireland as the set batter departs! This is a good-length ball, around off that angles away from the batter. Muhammad Younis looks to heave it away but it goes off the outside edge towards the keeper. Lorcan Tucker takes a sharp catch and Bahrain are in trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, on a length, on middle. Muhammad Younis skips down the track and mistimes his slog towards long on. A single taken.
On a length, on middle. David Mathias eases it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Muhammad Younis drags it to long on for a run.
Floated, on a length and outside off. Muhammad Younis looks for a slog-sweep but he fails to get any bat on it.
Fuller in length, on middle. David Mathias drills it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. David Mathias nudges it towards square leg.
Short of a length, outside off. Muhammad Younis looks to cut but it takes the underedge and onto the deck.
FOUR! EDGY! A short ball, around off. Muhammad Younis looks to pull but it goes off the top edge over the keeper's head and into the fence. This is turning out to be a good over for Bahrain!
A length ball, on middle. David Mathias nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Little bowls it fuller this time, outside off. David Mathias prods and carves it through the cover region for another boundary.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Slightly shorter in length, outside off. David Mathias hangs back and cuts it past the point fielder for a boundary.
On a length, around off. David Mathias taps it towards point.
Josh Little (2-0-15-0) is back on.
On the pads, Muhammad Younis gets low and sweeps it straight to short fine leg. At the halfway mark, Bahrain are 47/2. 112 needed from 60 balls! Ireland right on top at the moment.
This is pushed to mid off for a run.
On off, knocked back to the bowler again.
Loopy ball, on middle. Played back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Muhammad Younis hoicks it across the line to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, punched back to the bowler.
Short of a length, outside off. David Mathias taps it to point.
David Mathias is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another short ball and this time it does the trick. Short and on leg, Umar Toor shapes up for the pull shot but only gets a faint feather on that. Lorcan Tucker behind the stumps moves to his left and pouches it. Umar Toor stands in disbelief as he thinks there was no edge to it. But the umpire's decision is final and he has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball from Young, on off. Umar Toor looks to pull but misses.
WIDE! Length ball sprayed down the leg side. Umar Toor missed his flick. Craig Young appeals for a caught behind but the umpire signalled it as wide.
Outside off, Toor taps it to backward point.
Length ball, outside off. Muhammad Younis heaves it to deep square leg only for a run.
On a length, outside off. Umar Toor dabs it to third man for a single.
On middle, Muhammad Younis keeps it out.
Full and on middle, Umar Toor whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Umar Toor looks to cut it late but fails to get any contact.
Loopy ball, on leg. Toor works it to mid on.
Floats it up, outside off. Umar Toor cuts it to deep point for a brace.
On the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers for a single.
On a length, outside off. Muhammad Younis tries to cut but misses.
Short ball, outside off. Muhammad Younis swings but misses.
Umar Toor walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sarfaraz Ali was dropped earlier but could not make the most out of it. It was a length ball, on off. Sarfaraz Ali pumps it towards long on. Got the height but not the distance. Harry Tector is a very safe fielder and he takes the catch with ease. Bahrain lose their skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: A good yorker, on leg. Sarfaraz Ali looks to heave it away but misses it altogether.
Length ball, on middle. Muhammad Younis knocks it to mid on for a single.

Tossed up, on middle. Muhammad Younis kneels and lifts it towards long on. The fielder from mid on chases it and cuts it off. The batters are caught ball-watching and will only get a single. End of the Powerplay, Bahrain are 36/0.
Loopy ball, outside off. Sarfaraz Ali taps it to point for a run.
Floats it up, on leg. Muhammad Younis nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
On off, Muhammad Younis defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. Muhammad Younis blocks it out.
Full and outside off, Muhammad Younis looks to drive but misses.
Time for some spin! Simi Singh comes into the attack.

DROPPED! Gareth Delany gives a life to Sarfaraz Ali! Young serves a slower ball, on a length, around off. Sarfaraz Ali looks to slog but it goes off the outer half of the bat, in the air towards the cover-point region. Delany nestles under it but fails to pouch it. Two runs taken.
A length ball, on off. Muhammad Younis defends it to the off side and takes off for a run. The fielder at point has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Slightly shorter in length, on off. Muhammad Younis taps it towards backward point.
Back of a length, outside off. Muhammad Younis looks to cut but he misses.
Fuller in length, outside off. Muhammad Younis drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Young starts with a length ball, on off. Sarfaraz Ali toe-ends his heave towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Craig Young comes into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Muhammad Younis taps it to the off side and the ball goes past point for a couple of runs. This is a good start from Bahrain!
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Muhammad Younis looks to heave it away but he misses.
FOUR! A half-volley, angling in from off. Muhammad Younis hangs back and hoicks it over the mid on fielder. One bounce and over the ropes.
Fuller and wider, outside off. Sarfaraz Ali drills it down to long off and takes a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A slower ball, on a length, on middle. Sarfaraz Ali waits for it and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
A full ball, on middle. Muhammad Younis flicks it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Full ball, outside off. Sarfaraz Ali drives it through covers and bags a boundary.
A slower bumper, outside off. Sarfaraz Ali stays back and punches it to the man at extra cover, on the bounce.
Wide! A short ball but above the batter's head. Sarfaraz Ali ducks underneath and the umpire signals wide.
Back of a length, around off. Muhammad Younis taps it to the off side and sets off for a single.
A length ball, on off. Muhammad Younis blocks it solidly.
FOUR! Short of a length, on middle. Muhammad Younis pulls it handsomely through the mid-wicket region and collects a boundary.

Just wide of the fielder! Back of a length, on middle. Muhammad Younis sits back and heaves it through the mid-wicket region. The ball goes just past the fielder in the deep and he does well to stop it just in front of the ropes. Two runs taken!
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single. A sedate start from Bahrain. 5 runs off the 2 overs!
Around off. Muhammad Younis keeps it out.
On a length, outside off. Muhammad Younis pushes it towards cover but not in the gap.
Good-length ball, on middle. Sarfaraz Ali tucks it to the leg side for a single.
On a length, outside off. Ali keeps it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali looks to drive but he misses.
Wide! A full ball, way outside off. Sarfaraz Ali lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
Full and on off, kept out.
On the pads, nudged to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Sarfaraz Ali defends it out.
On a length, on middle. Sarfaraz Ali blocks it out.
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
